segments.name: DevSecOps platform
segments.description: Provides an intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps, delivered as a single application to software, security, IT and business teams worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company operates its business as one operating and reportable segment as the Company's chief operating decision maker ("CODM"), the Company's CEO, reviews financial information on a consolidated basis for purposes of allocating resources and evaluating financial performance.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription, license and professional services fees for the DevSecOps platform, priced by seats for platform tiers and by usage credits for AI agent capabilities.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer both seat-based and usage-based pricing to align costs with customer value realization and deployment patterns.
